title: Atlas manifest
description: web/src/atlas.json of an app: every screen and state the Atlas shoots. Checked by `boring-ui-blocks atlas <dir> --check`.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. ecritures.empty. Unique in the manifest.

title.description: What a person sees in the viewer.

flow.description: The flow this state belongs to.

after.description: Label of the arrow that leads to this state. Only with flow.

given.description: How the state is reached, in the grammar of an app's features/examples.json.

fixture.description: A file name in the app's features/fixtures/, matching *.synthetic.* (invented data only).

steps.description: In order: open <screen>, upload [<fixture>] (default given.fixture), click <label>, fill <label> <value>, wait <text> (atlas only). Quote a multi-word label or value "like this" or with guillemets.
